home.title: Etabat
home.description: Disputes you are involved in — filing, response, mediation, and arbitration
home.privacyNote: An Etab is not public. Only the dispute parties and the mediators or arbitrators selected by the system can see it. Cases where you are selected as a mediator or arbitrator appear in Fahs Mahs, not here.
home.empty: There are no Etabat in this filter.

case.todoTitle: What you need to do now: respond
case.todoText: You have two days to respond and upload evidence. If the deadline passes without a response, the case proceeds to mediation with this account only.
case.responseIntro: Write your account of what happened. Mediators read the complaint and response together before the first session.
case.whatHappenedHint: In chronological order — mention any circumstance that changed the schedule
case.solution: Do you have a proposed solution?
case.solutionHint: A written proposal can save a full mediation session
case.optionalHint: Optional — a reasonable proposal resolves many cases during mediation without arbitration.
case.uploadHint: PDF · PNG · JPG — up to 5 files
case.responseLock: After you send the response, you cannot edit it. You can add new evidence during mediation.

validation.responseRequired: Write your account before sending the response.
validation.responseMin: Your response must be at least 10 characters.

case.exchangeIntro: It was locked automatically when the complaint was filed. Both parties can see it, but nobody can edit it.
case.currencyHeld: The currency is held from the time the complaint was filed. It is not transferred until the case closes.
timeline: The claimant filed the complaint. The exchange file was locked and the currency was held.
Your turn. If the deadline passes, mediation continues without your response.
The system selects three mediators. It fails automatically if no settlement is reached in time.
Five arbitrators and a deposit per arbitrator apply to this balance-linked case.
A larger panel reviews the appeal with a doubled deposit.
